thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: PD-INC-3241 — High 5xx rate on inference-gateway-usw2. Threshold breached: 300m 5xx rate > 5%

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD-INC-3241 (unacked) — escalation to rotation oncall

alex: ack'ing — oncall is picking this up, standing by for scope. :white_check_mark:

sarah: grabbing logs now. seeing a sharp jump in 502s from reverse-proxy (edge) -> upstream inference-gateway

ben: noted. any customer reports?

maria: pm-senti shows a handful of 500-level errors in support queue, nothing major yet but a couple of failing API calls from a big customer (acme-inc). opening a support ticket.

alex: quick blast of metrics: 
```
# from metrics dashboard (last 10m)
5xx_rate: 6.8% (baseline ~0.4%)
p50_latency: 220ms -> 330ms
upstream_502s: increased x80 in 5m
kv_evictions: normal
```

alex: initial hypothesis: upstream keepalive/connection resets under burst -> proxy returning 502. can we validate with tcp resets?

sarah: pulling tcpdump from one affected host, will share short excerpt. seeing RSTs from upstream at ~12:32:15. Also connection queue length on gateway-03 is high.

ben: check autoscaler/backpressure? any recent deploys?

maria: no deploys in last hour. autoscaler shows a small spike in CPU but not saturated.

oncall-rotation: adding runbook link: https://runbook.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx-flood — follow step 1/2 (circuit-break fallback, isolate region)

alex: trying quick mitigation: enable short-lived fallback to cold model variant for route /v1/generate to reduce upstream concurrency. Applying traffic-split to 90% fallback, 10% primary now.

sarah: patching route rules — applied. monitoring.

incident-bot: Change applied: route-split v1/generate 90% -> fallback-model-quant. Triggered by alex at 1705550180

ben: 5xx rate dropping to 2.1% within 2m. p50 latency for fallback slightly higher but stable.

maria: support update prepared: "We observed transient 5xx errors affecting some customers; mitigation applied and we are monitoring. ETA for full recovery TBD."

alex: continuing validation: running qps->20k load test against canary to ensure no further cascade.

sarah: logs show specific upstream host inference-azb-07 returning 502s consistently. marking it for restart.

oncall-rotation: restarting inference-azb-07 now.

incident-bot: Host restart: inference-azb-07 (reboot initiated) — started at 1705550324

ben: after restart, upstream 502s from that host drop to zero. gateway 5xx rate falling under 0.6% and trending to baseline.

alex: good. begin rolling back traffic-split to normal over next 5m.

incident-bot: Traffic-split rollback applied by alex at 1705550390 — 100% -> primary model

maria: support note updated and sent to acme-inc contact. they acknowledged and will monitor on their side.

alex: root cause (preliminary): single upstream instance produced connection resets (suspected runaway thread/process) under a spike, causing proxy to surface 502s and amplify error rate. detailed postmortem will include reproducing RST pattern and health-check hardening.

oncall-rotation: handing off to next rotation for monitoring and postmortem: @sarah will own follow-up actions.

sarah: will take. creating a follow-up ticket INF-4872 with action items (healthcheck tightening, better alert tuning to detect single-host upstream RST patterns).

ben: tl;dr — mitigated via quick fallback routing + host restart; customer impact limited, support engaged. Closing pager. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Pager PD-INC-3241 acknowledged and resolved by alex at 1705550445

alex: closing thread — will post postmortem draft tomorrow. thanks all for quick triage. :metal:
